Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GOOGL.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 342 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 12% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2019.
Our gross margin expanded by 60 basis points to 61.2%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 12% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.

Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?

How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
